summary: This is a preliminary prospectus supplement filed by Codexis, Inc. under Rule 424(b)(5) for an underwritten public offering of common stock. The filing describes a proposed follow-on equity raise, not a special situation. The company is offering shares to raise capital; no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special-situation event is referenced. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction.
